final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and expressly conceded the key missing artifacts. The Actor's response is a narrower interpretation of the same record: aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support general readiness, but policy allows certification only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and any material segment weakness is disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. That compliance predicate is still unproven on this record. A caveated position can justify compliant_with_caveats when the caveat is a bounded residual issue around an otherwise satisfied predicate; here, the caveat is itself the unsatisfied predicate. The response improves precision by rejecting reliance on stale approval and informal monitoring, but that is reinterpretation of existing evidence, not new support for present compliance.
